vibe: Futuristic, premium, technical precision, JARVIS AI core. Holographic HUD aesthetic, steering clear of pure purple/magenta slop in favor of electric cyan, stark white, and warning amber.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl uppercase tracking-widest font-bold leading-none
scale.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium

dashboard_cards.hover_effect: border-color transitions to rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5), subtle inner glow inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,229,255,0.05)

layout.spacing: Tight padding within widgets (p-3 or p-4) to maximize data density. Use 1px borders everywhere to create a structural wireframe feel.
layout.structure: Three-pane or segmented HUD: Sidebar (History on left/right), Top Banner or Side Strip (System Status Indicators), Main Canvas (Chat). Elements should feel docked, not floating aimlessly.

motion.hover: Instant color shifts or border brightens. Fast interactions, no slow fades for technical elements.
motion.entrance: Staggered 'boot sequence' or 'system initializing' layout. Opacity fade in and slight translation. Consider a global initial loader.
motion.special_effects: Blinking cursors for AI typing. Glowing dots for 'ONLINE' status. Flickering numbers on load.

system_status_indicators.description: Small tactical widgets showing Router, Memory, Knowledge, Voice, Network.
system_status_indicators.style: Label in tracking-widest text-xs, Status (ONLINE/STDBY), blinking colored dot. Outline border.

chat_message_ai.style: Left aligned. border-l-2 solid #00E5FF. Monospace text for code, Plex Mono for body. Subtle cyan background tint (rgba(0,229,255,0.03)).

chat_message_user.style: Right aligned or indented. border-r-2 solid rgba(226, 241, 248, 0.3). Minimalist.

input_field.style: Flat background, strict cyan border on focus. Prefix with '>' or similar HUD prompt icon. No rounded pills.

classification_badge.style: Tiny uppercase label tracking-[0.2em], bordered, #00E5FF text. Positioned above or beside the message.

visual_enhancers.scanlines: Add a pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 background overlay with a repeating linear gradient to simulate CRT/HUD scanlines at 5-10% opacity.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)] on critical active text or icons (like the 'ONLINE' indicator dots).
visual_enhancers.hud_corners: Decorate main panels with 2px borders on just the corners (using linear-gradients or pseudo-elements) to simulate a target lock frame.

hud_background.description: Abstract neon digital polygon in dark space. Use as a very subtle (5-10% opacity) page background or overlay to add texture.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Rajdhani' (Headings/HUD labels) and 'IBM Plex Mono' (Body/Data) from Google Fonts.
Keep the background #05050B. Do not use generic Tailwind slate/gray backgrounds.
Build the dashboard using standard HTML/Tailwind for the structural control-room grid (Shadcn cards are too generic/rounded for this).
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements and key info nodes: status cards, chat inputs, send buttons, history list items.
For the 'scanning line' effect, add a global CSS overlay that creates the subtle horizontal HUD scanlines.
Ensure the system status dashboard (Router, Memory, Knowledge, Voice, Network) updates or pulses visually to feel 'alive'. Add a subtle animation to the 'ONLINE' indicator.
Replace standard rounded corners with crisp edges or maximum 2px radius to preserve the tactical/industrial feel.
